Public Function AdaptivePolicyV3SelfTest() As String
  Dim i As Long, text As String, checks As Long
  On Error GoTo Failed
  Call AdaptiveResetRun: AdaptiveEnabled = True: AccelBaselineRetry = False
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.9, False, 50#
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 16 And mV2Cooldown(1) = 0, "long poor pauses long only", checks
  PolicyAssert mV2Sample.Assessed And mV2Sample.Q = 0.9, "first correction assessed", checks
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.2, True, 400#, 350#
  PolicyAssert mV2Sample.Q = 0.9, "later fresh correction cannot replace first q", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 16, "current success retains fresh pause", checks
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 5
  PolicyAssert AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "long pause leaves short allowed", checks
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  PolicyAssert Not AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "long pause enforced", checks
  For i = 1 To 16
    AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
    AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  Next i
  PolicyAssert AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "long resumes after later successes", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 5
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.8, False, 50#
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(1) = 16 And mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "short poor pauses short only", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 8
  PolicyAssert AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "short pause leaves long allowed", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  mFreshSamples = 2: mFreshQ = 0.2
  P6FactorizationCount = 2: P6ProfFactorMs = 200#
  For i = 1 To 2
    AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
    AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
    AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
    AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.6, False, 200#
    PolicyAssert mV2Sample.CostKnown And mV2Sample.EstimatedNetMs < 0#, "measured price yields estimated loss", checks
    If i = 1 Then PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "one estimated loss does not suspend", checks
    AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  Next i
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 8 And mV2Cooldown(1) = 0, "two cost losses pause own path", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  mFreshSamples = 2: mFreshQ = 0.2
  P6FactorizationCount = 2: P6ProfFactorMs = 6#
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.6, False, 200#
  PolicyAssert Not mV2Sample.CostKnown And mV2Sample.CostStatus = "FACTOR_TIMER_FLOOR", "tiny-price estimates unavailable", checks
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "timer floor does not pause good reuse", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveV2aRejectedCorrection
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.1, True, 400#, 350#
  PolicyAssert Not mV2Sample.Assessed, "rejected first correction remains unassessed", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  text = PolicyLogSummary()
  PolicyAssert InStr(text, "PolicyV2_LONG_unassessed=1") > 0, "unassessed recorded", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0#, False, 10#
  PolicyAssert mV2Sample.Assessed And mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "zero residual is good", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 1, False

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.001
  mSamples = 3: mRate = 1#: mPreviousStep = 0.1: mIncrementStart = Timer - 1#
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 8, False
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(1) = 0 And mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "natural step shrink keeps both paths", checks
  PolicyAssert mCooldown(4) = 0 And mCooldown(5) = 0, "unused AA GMRES not paused by progress", checks
  PolicyAssert mNaturalStalls > 0, "natural stall classified", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.001
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveNoteCorrection 1#, 0.3, False, 20#
  mSamples = 3: mRate = 1#: mPreviousStep = 0.1: mIncrementStart = Timer - 1#
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 8, False
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "good reuse not blamed for step shrink", checks

  AdaptiveResetStage
  AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  AdaptiveUseMethod 2: AdaptiveV2aBeginUse
  AdaptiveFailedAttempt
  PolicyAssert mRecovery = 3 And mV2Cooldown(2) = 8 And mV2Cooldown(1) = 0, "failed long attempt isolated plus recovery", checks
  PolicyAssert Not mV2Active, "failed attempt closed before baseline", checks
  PolicyAssert mCooldown(4) = 0 And mCooldown(5) = 0, "unused methods not blamed for failure", checks
  AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, True
  For i = 1 To 3
    AdaptiveBeginIncrement 0#, 0.1
    AdaptiveEndIncrement True, 3, False
  Next i
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 5
  PolicyAssert AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "short returns after global recovery", checks
  AccelV2aPreviousIterations = 6
  PolicyAssert Not AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "long own pause survives global recovery", checks
  AdaptiveEnabled = False
  PolicyAssert AdaptiveAllowMethod(2), "adaptive off bypasses all pauses", checks
  Call AdaptiveResetStage: AdaptiveEnabled = True
  PolicyAssert mV2Cooldown(1) = 0 And mV2Cooldown(2) = 0 And mFreshSamples = 0, "stage resets model evidence", checks
  mPlainSamples = 4: mPlainQ = 0.8: mPlainMs = 10#
  AdaptiveNoteAA 1#, 0.99, 10#, True, "UNIT_COST"
  PolicyAssert mCooldown(4) = 8 And mV2Cooldown(1) = 0 And mV2Cooldown(2) = 0, "AA cost pause remains local", checks
  AdaptiveNoteGMRES 70#, False, True
  PolicyAssert mCooldown(5) = 64 And mGMRESBudgetStops > 0, "GMRES paid failure keeps budget pause", checks
  AdaptivePolicyV3SelfTest = "PASS: " & CStr(checks) & " assertions, separated paths, cost gate, progress classification, rejected-first handling, recovery"
  Exit Function
Failed:
  AdaptivePolicyV3SelfTest = "FAIL " & CStr(Err.Number) & " " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & PolicyLogSummary()
End Function

Private Sub PolicyAssert(ByVal ok As Boolean, ByVal label As String, ByRef checks As Long)
  checks = checks + 1
  If Not ok Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3710, "AdaptivePolicyV3SelfTest", label
End Sub
